This morning, I joined @SquawkCNBC to discuss my Stop Insider Trading Act.

My bill would prevent Members of Congress from buying new stocks once elected.  It would also require Members to notify the public of any sales of stocks they already own.

The House passed this commonsense legislation last night.  I am working with my Senate colleagues to get the Stop Insider Trading Act passed into law.

posts.text:
I met with Brian Johnson, President Trump’s nominee for Director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau.
Brian served as the Deputy Director of CFPB during President Trump’s first term.

I look forward to collaborating with Brian to protect Americans’ finances. Fraud costs hardworking Americans billions annually.  Together, we will work to combat fraud, waste, and abuse.

Water is the lifeblood of the valley.

I participated in a roundtable discussion with leaders from Gering Ft Laramie and Farmers Irrigation Districts in Scottsbluff last week.  They shared the impact of a very dry year on ag producers and the local community.

I appreciated the updates they provided and will continue to do my part to support our hardworking ag communities.

When I was Governor, we worked to strengthen mental health care in Nebraska.  As a result, U.S. News and World Report ranked Nebraska as having the fourth-best mental health in the nation.

One of the best ways to support mental well-being is by getting outside and getting active. This summer, I encourage all Nebraskans to join Nebraska Game and Parks’ Outdoor Nebraska 250-Mile Challenge.

This is a great way to explore our state and care for your well-being.
